title: Unlearning x Probe-Based Detection Blind Spot

original_idea.body: Whether unlearned knowledge stays linearly decodable in activations despite output suppression.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: probe-detectable residual knowledge means unlearning gives false assurance.
